differences.what: Testing becomes Testing history: a repeating section, up to 10, each titled Test {n}, with the test (choose-one), its date and its result, Positive, Negative, Pending or Unknown (added).
differences.why: PRD main 103 (Oct 19); inventory A34; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): the result options and the most tests

differences.what: Pregnancy stays among the tests of Testing history, as the line has it: an earlier pregnancy test is charted here with its date. Today's is the Pregnancy section's Pregnancy test, which alone opens Current pregnancy; a positive pregnancy test entered here opens nothing, and nothing stops the two from disagreeing.
differences.why: PRD main 104, 417; forms 6.5, 6.7; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #24): one pregnancy test twice, for the clinical team

differences.what: Choose-many. None is exclusive. The row has no Buttons: label. This follow-up (Results needed, Referral, PCP) is kept beside the Red flags and disposition note's, which is the visit's (forms 6.2): it says what the follow-up is for, and the phase 7 follow-up task reads only the Red flags note's.
differences.why: inventory A1, A4; forms 6.2; lifecycle 9.6; PLAN-OPEN (forms 10.1 #1): what phase 7 does with this follow-up
